summary: C5 touchdown notifications now construct and serialize a native-shaped local message, rebuild it with the native shared reader, and dispatch its decoded kind to the posting live plane's existing landing-state delivery.

rows.evidence: Existing seg42::construct_plane_touchdown_00762a60 constructs both the sent and decoded 20h message; 00769BD0/00769BE4 confirm the native factory's allocation size and constructor. Native C5h is supplied by the constructor, not a host literal payload.
C5h vtable 00D03518+4 points to 004645B0. Existing shared body writes the real constructed message header and +1Ch flag through canonical native bit-cursor bodies.
C5h vtable 00D03518+8 points to 004645D0. Existing shared body reads the loopback stream into the second constructed message; its decoded kind selects delivery to the posting plane.

rows.reason: C6h's constructor leaves the serialized push flag at +20h unwritten; the host only assumes zero and has no established producer for that byte. Recover its sender before adding a takeoff loopback.
The C6h writer reads message+20h, whose actual sender value has no established host producer; wiring it with the current assumed zero would invent payload state.
A real C6h sent payload, especially its +20h push byte, is missing; its reader must be wired together with that producer and receiver.

rows.host_site: src/game_hosts_session_messages.cpp: C5h profile slot 0Ch is recorded but not invoked
rows.reason: The host dispatches the decoded kind directly and has no class-inheritance IsType query to replace; an extra always-true C5h query would add no receiver behavior.
The raw body calls the native wake handoff on actual unit pointers; GameUnitGroupStorage explicitly carries one-based registry identities, so the required native unit/wake owners are missing.

The existing raw body still calls absolute Original allocator/constructor addresses and initializes a leader through native pointer state; a Source allocator/init adapter over real unit owners is missing.
Landing code explicitly lacks the enabled/value state of the native gear channel at ([plane+DECh]+28h); its current assumed-true gate is not real gear input for this raw body.
The host records the FX timer reset and FX step but has no persistent FX component/timer consumer; a standalone scratch timer would not affect the plane.
The persistent plane FX component, class-created effect/sound holders, and transform/listener callbacks required by the whole step are missing.
PointEffectConstruction requires the actual 008680B0 owner constructor, live template reference counts, and 0086A650 eligibility writes; no complete production adapter was established.

rows.host_site: src/game_hosts_units.cpp: UnitInstance::update_attachment; src/game_hosts_ship_ai.cpp: LandFort fire effect
rows.reason: The real point-effect owner constructor, retained template, current camera transform and eligibility implementation are missing at these record sites.
Both candidate shadow-fit callers remain uncalled by the built game; wiring the FOV getter there requires first establishing their shadow-owner production and render submission path.
No matching live two-dimensional lower-inclusive/upper-exclusive bounds consumer was established; the inspected collision host uses three-dimensional AABBs.

rows.host_site: src/press_start_screen.cpp: completed sign-in default reset; src/frontend_screens_cc13.cpp: options reset
rows.reason: No reachable single-player reset callback over the writable GameSettingsBlock was established; the live settings application publishes a read view of a separate native owner.
The abstract options callback has no live reset adapter for the writable settings owner; applying defaults to its read-view copy would not update the renderer's native settings state.
A production FORMATION_SET writer/reader adapter and native formation payload transport are missing; its constructor alone would leave the opaque/vector payload unused.
The breakup site records 98h and applies effects directly; a native message transport/dispatch consumer of its header has not been established.

construction.codec_adapter: Extracted SessionBoolMessageHost's four existing boundaries from Seg5Host; the single canonical 004645B0/004645D0 implementations retain their operations and now accept that narrower host.
construction.state: A real contact/wheel-height/airborne/vertical-velocity gate posts C5h for the live GameUnitSlot. Its complete constructor payload comes from binary constants and the existing session context. The posting plane retains its registry identity through synchronous delivery.
construction.switch_off: The previous direct landing-state delivery is extracted unchanged into deliver_plane_touchdown and invoked by the else arm; the enabled arm invokes it only through the decoded C5h kind. No transition runs twice.
construction.limitations: The existing synchronous delivery timing, projected session owner context, and remaining landing-state approximations are retained. This does not implement the native row-9 FIFO, arbitrary session virtual dispatch, or all of 007C71E0/007CB5F0.
